 Community outreach is a vital skill for any community organizer who wants to engage, mobilize, and empower people around a common cause. But how do you know if your outreach efforts are effective, and how can you use the feedback to improve your future strategies? In this article, you will learn how to conduct a community outreach evaluation, what tools and methods you can use, and how to apply the results to your decision-making process.

 Why evaluate your outreach? 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 Evaluating your outreach is not only a way to measure your impact, but also to learn from successes and challenges, and to improve relationships with stakeholders. Through evaluation, you can identify what worked and what didn't, assess progress towards goals, demonstrate accountability and credibility, celebrate achievements, recognize team efforts, and adjust plans and strategies based on feedback and data.
